documents.title: Calendar reminders
documents.text: A dismissed reminder stays dismissed on this device. To see it again, open the event and choose Restore reminder. Editing the event time alone does not restore it.

documents.title: Calendar reminders planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed calendar reminders. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Exported tables
documents.text: The table exporter writes UTF-8 CSV with a header row. Values containing commas are quoted. The first row is column names and must not be imported as a data record.

documents.title: Exported tables planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed exported tables. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Project access
documents.text: Removing someone from a project stops new access but does not erase files they previously downloaded. Transfer ownership before removing the last project owner.

documents.title: Project access planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed project access. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Conflicting note edits
documents.text: When two offline edits target the same note, synchronization retains both versions in a conflict panel. Choose a version or combine them manually; the service never silently chooses the newest timestamp.

documents.title: Conflicting note edits planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed conflicting note edits. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Missing attachment previews
documents.text: Preview generation accepts PDF and plain text. Unsupported files can still be downloaded. A missing preview does not imply that the uploaded file was lost.

documents.title: Missing attachment previews planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed missing attachment previews. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Archived workspaces
documents.text: Archiving a workspace makes it read-only. It preserves its notes and members. An administrator can restore write access by unarchiving it from workspace settings.

documents.title: Archived workspaces planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed archived workspaces. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Sorting by due date
documents.text: Items without a due date appear after dated items, even when the direction is descending. Equal dates retain their previous relative order.

documents.title: Sorting by due date planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed sorting by due date. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Retrying an upload
documents.text: After a disconnected upload, retry with the same upload identifier. The service resumes acknowledged chunks. Creating a new identifier starts a separate upload instead.

documents.title: Retrying an upload planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed retrying an upload. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Draft publication
documents.text: Saving a draft does not make it visible to readers. Publishing creates an immutable revision. Further edits remain in a new draft until the next explicit publication.

documents.title: Draft publication planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed draft publication. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Activity history
documents.text: The activity view records who changed a field and its previous value. Exporting history requires the audit-reader permission, which does not grant permission to edit the underlying record.

documents.title: Activity history planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed activity history. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Recurring meetings
documents.text: A recurring meeting follows the organizer’s named time zone. During daylight-saving changes, its UTC hour may move while its local start hour stays fixed.

documents.title: Recurring meetings planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed recurring meetings. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Search result snippets
documents.text: Snippets display the matched passage and its document title. A high rank is a relevance estimate, not verification that the passage answers the question. Open the document to inspect its context.

documents.title: Search result snippets planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed search result snippets. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Restoring removed pages
documents.text: Removed pages stay in the trash until permanent deletion. Restoring a page preserves its identifier and incoming links. A permanently deleted page cannot be restored from the trash.

documents.title: Restoring removed pages planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed restoring removed pages. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Import validation
documents.text: An import first validates every row, then commits the complete batch. A malformed row rejects the batch and leaves existing records unchanged. Fix the reported row before retrying.

documents.title: Import validation planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed import validation. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Quiet notification periods
documents.text: Quiet periods suppress push notifications while retaining events in the activity feed. They do not disable email subscriptions. Email preferences are configured separately.

documents.title: Quiet notification periods planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed quiet notification periods. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Shared links
documents.text: A private sharing link is tied to one revision and can be revoked. Revoking it prevents future access through that link; it does not remove downloaded copies or other independently created links.

documents.title: Shared links planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed shared links. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Undo after reopening
documents.text: Undo history is local to the current editing session. Closing the editor clears that history. Saved revisions remain available in version history after reopening.

documents.title: Undo after reopening planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed undo after reopening. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Storage quota errors
documents.text: When saving would exceed the storage quota, the previous committed snapshot remains readable. Free space or export unused attachments, then retry. A failed save must not be displayed as saved.

documents.title: Storage quota errors planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed storage quota errors. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Offline preparation
documents.text: Offline readiness requires retained application files, model artifacts and a complete document index. Caching only the page shell is insufficient for local search after disconnection.

documents.title: Offline preparation planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed offline preparation. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Cancelling indexing
documents.text: Cancelling indexing keeps the previous complete index. Work already submitted to the GPU finishes before cleanup. A cancelled partial index is never published as the current index.

documents.title: Cancelling indexing planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed cancelling indexing. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Document identity
documents.text: The importer uses a stable document identifier independent of the title and content hash. Renaming a document preserves its identifier. Equal text in two documents does not merge their identities.

documents.title: Document identity planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed document identity. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Embedding upgrades
documents.text: Changing embedding models invalidates stored vectors from the prior embedding space. Rebuild them from preserved documents. Changing only the reranker does not require re-embedding unchanged documents.

documents.title: Embedding upgrades planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed embedding upgrades. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Keyboard selection
documents.text: Shift plus an arrow extends the current selection. Escape clears the selection without deleting text. The Delete key removes selected text and can be undone during the current editing session.

documents.title: Keyboard selection planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed keyboard selection. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.

documents.title: Backup verification
documents.text: A successful export confirms that a backup file was written. Verification imports that backup into an isolated workspace and compares document identifiers and content. Keep the original workspace intact during verification.

documents.title: Backup verification planning note
documents.text: Planning note: the team discussed backup verification. This note records the meeting topic only; it does not specify the feature behavior, access rules, recovery procedure, or configuration.
